findings.finding: Large output could force the excerpt reader to load the entire stream and command output lacked an explicit ceiling.
changes: Excerpt reads only the first 4 KB instead of loading the complete stream.
Combined stdout and stderr default ceiling is 10 MB.
Ceiling termination is recorded as output_limit_exceeded with observed exit 125.
Receipt JSON remains bounded while full captured-byte hashes are retained.

findings.finding: Receipt output path could be supplied outside the declared root.
changes: Receipt path and resolved parent must stay inside the root before a command is run or a receipt is written.

findings.finding: Known AWS-style credentials could remain in display excerpts.
changes: Added AWS access-key IDs, labeled secret-access keys/passwords, and private-key block shapes to best-effort redaction.
Kept the explicit warning that arbitrary secrets may remain.

findings.finding: Missing HMAC key, wrong key, key-id tamper, or signed-to-unsigned downgrade might be accepted.
changes: Existing negative tests already rejected all four cases when authenticated verification is requested.
Authentication now rejects unexpected fields and malformed tags.

findings.finding: Receipt schema and runtime verification should reject a self-consistent but malformed receipt.
changes: Expanded the bundled JSON Schema to the full v1 body, command, selection, artifact, Git, and integrity contract.
Added strict runtime body validation after integrity or HMAC succeeds and before any receipt-controlled path is used.

findings.finding: Timeout and execution authority could be misread in CI or on Windows.
changes: README, receipt contract, security policy, skill, and CLI help now state that the command uses caller permissions and is not sandboxed.
Timeout 124 and output-limit 125 are documented as cross-platform observed receipt codes; the ShipProof CLI returns 1 for either non-passing run.

findings.finding: Codex quick-start and contribution instructions were hard to discover.
changes: Added a copy-paste Codex request with narrow claims and includes.
Linked the pre-existing CONTRIBUTING.md and expanded its local verification commands.

findings.finding: Live selected-symlink creation test is skipped when Windows privileges do not permit symlink creation.
findings.reason: The production branch rejects selected paths for which Path.is_symlink is true, and the test runs when the OS grants symlink creation. The private pilot does not change host Developer Mode or elevation.

findings.finding: Add MSI, Chocolatey, a prebuilt wheel, dry-run mode, nonce, and pluggable redaction.
findings.reason: These expand distribution or API surface and are not required to test the v0.1 receipt contract.

findings.finding: The repository lacked CONTRIBUTING.md and Code of Conduct.
findings.reason: Both files existed before the panel; discoverability was improved instead.

findings.finding: The receipt stored the full output in its excerpt field.
findings.reason: The receipt excerpt was already limited to 4 KB. The implementation did read the complete temporary stream into memory before slicing; that real defect was fixed.

synthetic_panel_boundary: No real users were recruited and no adoption, star, download, or satisfaction claim is made.

logo_routing_repair_review.review_path: private maintainer evidence; excluded from the public candidate

visual_only_revision_binding.scope: Agent Smith palette canonical master, brand tokens, opaque-source renderer support, deterministic derivatives, and package validation only; no plugin behavior change
